feedback.details: The diagram parses via mmdc (exit 0), but violates contract requirements: (1) Contract mandates 'graph TD or C4Context syntax' — file uses flowchart LR (line 4). (2) Contract requires 'exactly 4-5 Container nodes' — diagram contains 14 nodes including actors, nested sub-nodes, and out-of-scope services, far exceeding the limit. (3) All 18 edges use `-->` (lines 30-55) rather than the explicitly typed edge syntax (`->`, `-.->`, `<-->`) the contract demands for bidirectional flows.

File completely fails to define any of the 5 required container nodes. Contract requires: 'mobile app, web interface, QR scanner, photo capture, Hermes agent' as distinct Container nodes matching PRD terminology. Instead: (1) gardener as Actor (line 6) — not a container. (2) Single 'Mobile App Frontend' subgraph (line 13) with 6 internal components merges all frontend concerns — not 5 distinct containers. (3) backend, db, qr_service, printer_service (lines 23-26) — out-of-scope. No node matches PRD terminology. No one-sentence responsibility descriptions anywhere in the file.

File is 54 lines with ZERO narrative text beyond YAML frontmatter (lines 1-3). No structured mapping table linking containers to FR41-FR45 IDs. grep for 'FR41', 'FR42', 'FR43', 'FR44', 'FR45' returns zero matches. grep for 'PRD' returns zero matches. Entire narrative section required by sprint contract is absent.

Sprint is 'Frontend Container' — should scope only frontend. Diagram includes: (1) Backend API (line 23) — not frontend. (2) Plant Database (line 24) — backend concern. (3) QR Code Service (line 25) — backend service. (4) Printer Service (line 26) — backend service. (5) Phomemo M120 (line 8) — external hardware. No [Post-MVP] tags appear anywhere. Contract states: 'Zero tolerance for out-of-scope components' and 'Scope creep is grounds for contract rejection.'

Multiple edges lack the three required elements (protocol, payload format, authentication): (1) Line 39: 'Reads/writes cached data via' — incomplete, no protocol or payload. (2) Line 31: 'Captures photos via camera' — no protocol or payload. (3) Line 36: 'Triggers API calls via SWR hooks' — SWR is a library, not a transport protocol. (4) Line 40: 'Sends messages via Telegram API' — no payload format or auth. Contract requires: 'Every external link must specify exact protocol (HTTPS/MQTT/BLE/HTTP), payload format (JSON/XML/Protobuf), and authentication method.'

markdownlint reports errors: (1) MD013 at line 13: 89 characters exceeds 80-char limit. (2) MD047 at line 55: file does not end with a single newline. Additionally: (a) No H1 heading — YAML frontmatter at line 2 is not a markdown heading. Contract requires 'exactly one H1'. (b) No H2 headings — no section hierarchy exists. (c) Mermaid diagram not wrapped in fenced code block with language tag (line 4). Contract requires 'Fenced code blocks must specify language tags (mermaid, typescript, json)'.

Zero documentation of offline queue/sync. Only mention is node label 'Local Storage (IndexedDB, localStorage)' at line 18 — a node definition, not schema. No local storage schema, queue capacity limits, conflict resolution strategy (LWW vs manual merge), timeout thresholds, data eviction policies, or sync backoff strategy. No FR31-FR35 references. Contract states: 'Failure to specify data eviction policies or sync backoff results in rejection.'

Zero documentation of Hermes degradation/fallback. No fallback UI states, data staleness tolerance (>24h flagged), user notification mechanism, explicit error boundaries, retry backoff strategy (exponential, capped at 5 mins), or graceful degradation paths for any frontend container. The 'hermes_client' node at line 19 is a bare label with no operational behavior.

Zero documentation of data privacy or encryption. No mention of: (1) AES-256 or equivalent for data at rest. (2) TLS 1.2+ for data in transit. (3) Prohibition on plaintext logging of PII/QR data/camera metadata. (4) PRD security constraint references. The 'storage' node (line 18) stores data locally but no encryption-at-rest is mentioned.

Zero performance specifications. No mention of: (1) Maximum acceptable render time (<200ms initial paint). (2) Interaction latency (<50ms). (3) Memory allocation limits. (4) Garbage collection considerations for long-running queues. Contract requires these explicitly.

overall_summary: This file is fundamentally incomplete as a Sprint 3 C2 Container deliverable. It consists of only 54 lines: a 3-line YAML frontmatter header and raw Mermaid diagram text without any fenced code block, with zero narrative text. The diagram uses flowchart LR instead of contract-mandated graph TD/C4Context, contains 14 nodes instead of the required 4-5, and includes multiple out-of-scope backend components with no [Post-MVP] tagging. All 5 required containers (mobile app, web interface, QR scanner, photo capture, Hermes agent) are absent as distinct nodes — frontend concerns are collapsed into a single 'Mobile App Frontend' subgraph. No mapping table links containers to FR41-FR45 IDs. All four edge case criteria (offline queue/sync, Hermes degradation, data privacy/encryption, performance/latency) are completely unaddressed. The file fails 7 of 10 criteria at score 1.0-2.0 (Critical severity).
